question.text: The minimum net worth requirement for an Asset Management Company (AMC) under SEBI (Mutual Fund) Regulations is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series V-A workbook (p65), effective January 01, 2024 the AMC must have a net worth of not less than Rs. 50 crore. Page 66 confirms this required net worth must be maintained continuously, and page 64 supports that the trustees review the AMC's net worth on a quarterly basis to ensure ongoing compliance. The Trap: Rs. 10 crore relates to other sponsor-side financial criteria and is not the AMC's net worth requirement. Rs. 100 crore is not the regulatory figure. Rs. 25 crore is a distractor — the keyed regulatory floor under the current workbook is Rs. 50 crore (p65-p66). Note: Two distinct compliance checks operate together — the Rs. 50 crore minimum and the requirement that it be maintained continuously, with quarterly trustee oversight (p64-p66).
